mapper.select: where status != 'DELETED' order by coalesce(parent_menu_id, 0), display_order, menu_id
select count(*) from menus where menu_id = #{menuId} and status != 'DELETED'
mapper.update: update menus set system_use_yn = #{systemUseYn}, exposure_start_at = #{exposureStartAt}, exposure_end_at = #{exposureEndAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, change_reason = #{changeReason} where menu_id = #{menuId} and status != 'DELETED'
